title: Shorter enrichment context
reader_summary: Compress web/HN enrichment text before Claude writes Skills blurbs, so we spend fewer tokens on fluff and keep the facts.
how_we_measure: Primary: enrichment/input token cost and output tokens vs baseline. Must not drop rank-1 rubric pass rate or Why-now quality. PostHog secondary.

reader_glossary.meaning: A Claude Code skill (JuliusBrussee/caveman) and OmniRoute RTK+Caveman pattern: strip verbose prose in agent context; leave code, paths, and facts. We did not install Caveman. We compress Firecrawl/HN enrichment bundles before narration, not agent output.

hypothesis: Compressing enrichment context before narration cuts input/output tokens without lowering rubric pass rate or Why-now quality.
change_summary: Add DIGEST_ENRICH_COMPRESS=1 on both the OSS and Skills digest commands (compress enrich bundles before narrate).
notes: Queued #3 after humanizer polish. Distinct from Ponytail (output writing rules). Distinct from Humanizer (post-polish). Requires Firecrawl enrich still on. Lab post: briefings/lab/posts/EXP-20260913-caveman-compress-skills.md. 2026-09-26: extended to run on both OSS and Skills digests per Brian (id keeps its -skills suffix for continuity). Code implemented 2026-10-10: DIGEST_ENRICH_COMPRESS (deterministic pre-narrate compress + token log before/after enrich chars). Keep flag off in digest.yml until treatment 2026-11-08.
